application_path: Explicit final-machine output-only adapter imports app.micro.registry and app.micro.anim.AnimatedModel, routes reviewed outputs away from originals, invokes register_review with refined builder + synchronized animation.
app.micro.registry.register appends id pancreas_review_20261004 to MODELS without changing pancreas.
app.viewer.catalog.load_catalog converts that id into ProceduralEntry. Register before catalog construction.
Native model selector opens ProceduralEntry.load → ProceduralModel → ModelView. ProceduralModel copies viewer_cameras and start_view. Home selects V1; Views menu reaches V2–V8.
ModelViewport.set_named_view resolves hidden by exact item keys; native slider starts bulk items at 50% and requires explicit opening-opacity validation.
deferred_acceptance: Normal selector includes both original and distinct review entry and both open independently.
V1 restores exact visibility and cut state after prior isolation, sections and separation.
Opaque specimen at tissue opacity 100% teaches tissue rather than a large support mold.
V2 coherent basal/apical/nuclear ownership under basal hiding; centroid-origin relationship remains recognizable on restoration.
V3 true luminal junction continuity and explicit boundary cut distinctions.
V4 human mixed cell arrangement; vascular surface exchange relationship; hiding one cell type retains ownership.
V5 graph supply/exchange/drainage meaning; no ambiguous rail/fragments.
V6/V7 owner tissues restored and secretion receiving compartment still apparent; cap/cut passes follow morphs.
V8 context-only surfaces readable, smooth fitted passages and bounded sampling explanation.
Roundtrip retains corrected names, descriptions, cameras, scale note and synchronized animation.

ownership_overlays.scope: Thin complete host shells and fluid-domain overlays retained with acinar interiors, not treated as separate physiologic compartments or full-scale opaque anatomy.
